Vote - AcceptText - See Berkes' comments. I asked C. Balamoshev to resubmit this with fewer corrections. I encouraged entering the text more or less as found in the edition and then returning to it once it has appeared in papyri.info to suggest improvements to the text. In lin9 adopt Balamoshev's original suggestion.

Vote - AcceptText - R: l4: delete extra space after (Π̣άσον(ος)) l8: => <#δ '=1/4#> l9: ἐλ(αβομένων) is still problematic, I wouldn't include this form in DDbDP (see CB's comments). The reading is dubious to say the least. Perhaps add a reg? But what form? Next voter? V: l4: => <#δ '=1/4#> l5: => 5. Συμε̣ῶ̣[νος] [ l8: => (Γεωργί(ου)) (λαναρ(ίου)) l9: => 9. $m2 vestig
Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - I am returning this to you as a trial case.

Text from printed edition. In line 4 after checking the photo I've corrected Πάσονος -> Πάσωνος, which was then confirmed by a simple search in the PN (Πάσονος no instances btw). In line 6 I've corrected Γεωργ<ί>ου -> Γεωργίο(υ), as can be seen in the photo. In line 8, I've regularized <κ>ελαρ(ί)τ(ου) -> κελλαρίτου in the apparatus. In line 9 I've changed ἐλ(αβομένων) -> ε̣λ( ), as such form doesn't exist and thus the expansion is dubious. In line 11 I've corrected φουσκα(ρίου) -> φουσκ(αρίου), after checking the photo, and regularized the grammar in ἐκ νο(μίσματα) -> ἐκ νο(μισμάτων). The same in line 14 where (ὐπὲρ) νο(μίσματα) -> (ὑπὲρ) νο(μισμάτων). On the verso side, in line 8 I've changed δ(ο)θ( ) Γεωργί(ου) λαναρ(ίου) -> δ(ο)θ( ) Γεωργί( ) λαναρ(ί ), as the case could be dative as well, smth like: δοθέντα Γεωργίῳ λαναρίῳ. Attention should be also paid to line 2 where the number of nomismata is 3 1/2, but in the German translation 3 1/3.
